favorites_show_less.title: Show less
favorites_show_less.note: Button label to display fewer items

favorites_show_more.title: Show more ({count} remaining)
favorites_show_more.note: Button text to show hidden items. {count} will be replaced with the number of remaining favorite items to show, including the parentheses. Example: 'Show more (18 remaining)'

favorites_menu_title.title: Favorites
favorites_menu_title.note: Used as a label in a customization menu

favorites_add.title: Add Favorite
favorites_add.note: A button that allows a user to add a new 'favorite' bookmark to their existing list

favorites_trackers_badgeLabel.title: Trackers from {count} companies blocked on this site
favorites_trackers_badgeLabel.note: Accessible label for a small badge on a favorite tile. {count} is a number greater than 1. Example: 'Trackers from 12 companies blocked on this site'

favorites_trackers_badgeLabelSingular.title: Trackers from 1 company blocked on this site
favorites_trackers_badgeLabelSingular.note: Accessible label for a small badge on a favorite tile, when trackers from exactly one company were blocked

favorites_trackers_companies.title: {count} companies tried to watch you browse {site} this week
favorites_trackers_companies.note: Title of a list of tracking companies blocked on a favorite site in the past 7 days. {count} is a number greater than 1. {site} is the site's domain, eg: 'cnn.com'

favorites_trackers_companiesSingular.title: 1 company tried to watch you browse {site} this week
favorites_trackers_companiesSingular.note: Title of a list of tracking companies blocked on a favorite site in the past 7 days, when there's exactly one. {site} is the site's domain, eg: 'cnn.com'

favorites_trackers_more.title: and {count} more
favorites_trackers_more.note: Closes a short list of tracking companies, counting the ones not listed. {count} is a number greater than 1. Example: 'and 9 more'

favorites_trackers_moreSingular.title: and 1 more
favorites_trackers_moreSingular.note: Closes a short list of tracking companies when exactly one wasn't listed

favorites_trackers_blocked.title: DuckDuckGo blocked them all {count} times they tried.
favorites_trackers_blocked.note: Closes a list of tracking companies on a favorite site: DuckDuckGo blocked every tracking attempt in the past 7 days. {count} is the number of attempts, always greater than 1

favorites_trackers_blockedSingular.title: DuckDuckGo blocked it the one time it tried.
favorites_trackers_blockedSingular.note: Closes a list of tracking companies on a favorite site, when there was exactly one tracking attempt in the past 7 days, and DuckDuckGo blocked it
